relations: The wooden disc is clamped to a vertical post; loosening the clamp may allow the disc to tilt or fall.
The metal ladder stands against the wall; applying weight to its steps will compress the structure or shift its base.
The broom leans against the wall; a lateral push or vibration could cause it to slide or topple.
Loose tools rest on the workbench; bumping the surface will cause them to shift or drop.
